Class UserService

java.lang.Object
app.user.UserLookupService
app.user.UserService
@Service public class UserService extends UserLookupService
Reads business accounts on behalf of their owners, and records their acceptance of the platform terms.

  • Field Details

    • CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION

      public static final String CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION
      The version of the platform terms in force, named by its effective date. Change it whenever the wording of the terms changes: every client then has no acceptance for the new version and is asked to accept again.

    • getOwnAccount

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public User getOwnAccount(UUID userId)
      Loads the account belonging to the given user. Callers pass the id from the verified token, never an id supplied in the request, so a client can only read its own account. Includes cash reserved by open buy orders.
      Overrides:
      getOwnAccount in class UserLookupService
      Parameters:
      userId - the caller's user id from the token's sub claim
      Returns:
      the caller's account
      Throws:
      UserNotFoundException - if the caller has not registered a business account

    • hasAcceptedCurrentTerms

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public boolean hasAcceptedCurrentTerms(UUID userId)
      Reports whether the given user has accepted the terms currently in force. An acceptance of an earlier version does not count.
      Parameters:
      userId - the caller's user id from the token's sub claim
      Returns:
      true if the user accepted CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION

    • acceptTerms

      @Transactional public void acceptTerms(UUID userId, String termsVersion)
      Records that the given user accepted the terms currently in force.

      The caller names the version they were shown, so an acceptance is never recorded against wording the user did not see. Accepting again changes nothing: the first acceptance and its time stand.

      The profile row is locked for the rest of the transaction, so two requests from the same user cannot both find no acceptance and both insert one.

      Parameters:
      userId - the caller's user id from the token's sub claim
      termsVersion - the version of the terms the user was shown
      Throws:
      ConflictException - if termsVersion is not the version in force
      UserNotFoundException - if the caller has not registered a business account
